title: Masterwork gear: Legendary, every 3 levels up to 30
changes: Brann's masterwork pieces are now Legendary with four bonuses at their highest, sold at levels 15, 18, 21, 24, 27 and 30 (pick the level in the shop)
They are expensive: 10,000 gold at level 15 up to 100,000 at level 30 (they sell back like any Legendary)
Hovering a piece in the shop shows the stats you would get even if you don't meet its needs yet, and each piece lists what it needs in red
Quest marker: the gold ring sits centred on the target, and the arrow circles the middle of your hero
/max gives 1,000,000 gold to try the masterwork gear
